params.prompt:
Create a new, substantially more refined interior finish and furniture proposal by EDITING THIS REAL ROOM PHOTO. This must remain the same 15 ft 1 in by 17 ft great room, same eye-level corner camera and perspective. ARCHITECTURE LOCK: retain the existing terrace double glazing on the left with its original divisions; exactly TWO high horizontal three-pane windows, one on each side of the central fireplace chase; their exact locations and sizes; existing flat ceiling height, crown moulding, wall planes and room width. No new windows or openings, no invented tray ceiling, no wide hotel lobby. Preserve the visible neighboring Crown townhomes and apartments outdoors. TV is now mounted above the fireplace, centered on the original chase: deliberate owner override; remove original TV from right wall bay. Keep gas insert in its original position and size. All other changes are finishes, furniture and lighting.

DESIGN GOAL: architect-designed contemporary private residence with boutique hotel quality. Cocoa / deep espresso brown wood, polished SILVER chrome, soft white Cloud sofa and white lounge chairs, sophisticated blue accents. Achieve richness through proportion, beautifully joined materials, layered textures and deliberate restraint. Avoid generic furniture showroom styling: NO matching mushroom lamps, no set of identical blue cushions and splatter-art prints, no cheap slab-front credenzas with long metal bar pulls, no LED RGB glow, no fluting everywhere, no decorative clutter, no shiny gold, no faux palace. NOT an all-beige room. No yellow in this round.

FURNITURE AND MILLWORK: keep the main big cloud-like modular sofa along the source foreground/left facing the fireplace, now generously cushioned soft warm WHITE woven upholstery with visible quality stitching and deep comfortable seats. Two white sculptural low lounge chairs in the approximate original chair locations, curved back and clean welt details, concealed bases. Remove the original central upholstered ottoman. Replace with a substantial low rounded-rectangle honed taupe stone coffee table, thick-edged top, recessed solid dark-cocoa base; one small polished-chrome low accent table beside one chair. Usable walkways, no overfilled room.

The two flanking consoles are elegant bespoke-looking DEEP COCOA / espresso walnut storage: rich visible matched wood grain, a thick subtly rounded solid-looking perimeter, carefully aligned doors, fine narrow shadow reveals, discreet integrated finger pulls, thin honed stone tops. They are low and grounded all the way to the floor on continuous recessed dark plinths. NO little feet, legs, open frame bases or floating wall hung consoles. Distinguish this from generic flat brown boxes through refined veneer grain, craftsmanship and depth at edges. Keep cabinet sizes within the actual bays. Above each console and below the real high window hang a beautifully composed abstract artwork, sibling artworks with different compositions, chalk white with deep ink blue, smoky grey and tiny tobacco-brown gestural marks. Fine dark frames with restrained polished-silver inner edge. Art does not cover window trim.

One sculptural silver-chrome lamp with a softly glowing opal glass form on the right console only; no matching lamp on the other console. Slim polished-silver picture lights illuminate the two artworks; subtle warm pools of light with neutral daylight balance, no yellow cast. Fine full-height ripple-fold ivory sheers at the real left glazing, densely gathered stackback and clean hem. Large tactile ivory/taupe wool rug with quiet tonal abstract relief, exposed medium-light neutral oak floor border. Small number of carefully placed objects: two large books, a hand-shaped dark ceramic vessel, a living green plant. Deep muted blue in a couple of differently textured cushions and one relaxed throw; keep most upholstery white, no matching accessory kit. Photoreal editorial interior photograph, detailed natural materials, real shadows, normal residential scale, bright soft daylight. No people, text, labels, watermarks or collage.
VERSION D: rich warm mineral finish. Walls are a softly clouded warm mushroom/putty mineral plaster with very fine, subtle tonal depth; visibly deeper than the white furniture but still luminous. Reface ONLY the existing fireplace chase from floor to its existing crown in pale honed warm-grey limestone with large calm surfaces, precise narrow joints and a modest horizontal ledge at the source ledge height; do not widen it or reshape the room. TV above, slim charcoal soundbar below TV. Stone must have fine fossil/cloud variation and soft matte texture, not vivid veins or shiny marble. Keep the original hearth/insert position. Crown and window trim remain in their source forms, painted a slightly lighter warm putty; ceiling soft warm white. Silver details glint quietly against the textured walls. Art and fabrics provide confident but edited ink-blue notes. This version should feel mature, deeply comfortable, and quietly expensive, NOT washed out or bland.
